$comment: Medium-tier planner verdict per ADR-0016 rubric bands (bench/rubrics/medium-scored.json). Scoring authority: Perplexity Max (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Perplexity Computer) per rubric self_scoring_prohibited + planner_authority=perplexity_max. Planner cells produce a complete plan JSON in one turn — no capture-scope caveat (unlike coder tier). Scores map directly to rubric bands. Post-hoc edit locked per ADR-0022.
quality_metric: 0-100 rubric band score per task, macro-average across 10 tasks
tiebreak: quality-first; ties within 3 points resolved by lower total wall_seconds across all tasks

01-add-auth-endpoint.notes: All 6 gold elements present (models, hash verify, JWT create, DB query, endpoint, tests); DAG valid; endpoint depends on helpers. 90-100 band.

02-migrate-database.notes: Correct zero-downtime ordering: migration -> deploy migration -> model -> queries -> soft-delete rewrite -> tests -> canary deploy -> monitor -> rollout. Deploy migration before code changes (s2 before s3). Missing explicit include_deleted flag consideration (-3); rest is 90-100 band.

03-refactor-callback-to-async.notes: Inventory -> async equivalents -> refactor internals -> preserve public API via wrappers -> async tests. Backward compat preserved via s4 wrappers. Missing explicit DeprecationWarning step (-2 from 90). 70-89 band top edge.

04-add-caching-layer.notes: Full coverage: Redis client, key convention, serialization, read-through, TTL set, explicit invalidation function (s7), integrated into update/delete (s8), unit + integration tests. Explicit invalidation is the key discriminator — hits 90-100 band cleanly.

05-split-monolith.notes: scaffold -> move -> config -> refactor imports -> test -> build -> publish -> depend -> remove original -> update remaining imports. Publish (s7) before depend (s8) — correct ordering. 90-100 band.

06-add-rate-limiting.notes: Key function 'user ID or IP address' handles both auth/unauth cases; middleware + 429 + Retry-After all present; tests present. Missing explicit per-user-independence test coverage (-8 from 90). 70-89 band.

07-add-observability.notes: Deps -> env config -> TracerProvider -> MeterProvider -> global providers -> auto-instrumentation -> custom spans -> custom metrics -> InMemorySpanExporter tests. All discriminators hit. 90-100 band.

08-graphql-migration.notes: Service-layer refactor (s2), types (s3), DataLoader (s4), resolvers (s5), mount alongside REST (s6), integration tests (s7). All three discriminators addressed. 90-100 band.

09-incident-response.notes: Ack+severity -> diagnose -> correlate -> mitigate -> verify -> RCA -> permanent fix -> postmortem. Mitigation (s4) before RCA (s6) — critical ordering correct. 90-100 band.

10-mcp-server-scaffold.notes: Explicit ADR-0019 references (s8 port range, s9 mode wrapper), schemas (s4), tool handlers (s5-s7), registry integration (s10), init (s3). ADR-0019 surfacing is the key discriminator. 90-100 band.

01-add-auth-endpoint.notes: 5 steps: models, password verify, JWT, endpoint, tests. Missing explicit User model step (assumes it exists) — minor gap. DAG valid, deps sequenced correctly. 90-100 band edge.

02-migrate-database.notes: WRONG ORDERING: s6 deploys application code before s7 executes database migration. Application code references deleted_at column that doesn't exist on live DB at s6 — production would break. Rubric explicitly caps this at 70-89 band ('sequences deploy-migration after the model change (breaks zero-downtime)').

03-refactor-callback-to-async.notes: Inventory -> async API -> refactor internals -> wrapper bridge -> orchestration update -> tests. Backward compat preserved via s4 wrappers. Missing DeprecationWarning step (-3 from 90). 70-89 band top.

04-add-caching-layer.notes: Read-through wrapper (s4) + explicit invalidation function (s5) both present. Missing explicit integration of s5 invalidation into update/delete DB write paths — s5 exists but isn't wired in. Also missing integration tests (only unit). 70-89 band.

05-split-monolith.notes: scaffold -> copy -> refactor -> tests -> publish -> depend -> update imports -> remove original -> run full suite. Publish (s5) before depend (s6) — correct. 90-100 band.

06-add-rate-limiting.notes: 'User identifier' in s4 handles both auth/unauth abstractly; 429 handler + Retry-After present; integration tests present. Missing explicit per-user-independence test — 70-89 band top.

07-add-observability.notes: TracerProvider + MeterProvider + auto-instrumentation + custom spans + tests all present. Metrics initialized (s5) AFTER custom spans (s4) — inverted from typical ordering but functionally valid. Env config only in s2, no default OTLP endpoint noted. 70-89 band.

08-graphql-migration.notes: Service-layer refactor (s3), types (s2), DataLoader (s5), resolvers (s4), mount alongside REST (s6), tests (s7). REST preservation implicit but stated. All three discriminators hit. 90-100 band edge.

09-incident-response.notes: Ack -> correlate -> rollback (mitigate) -> verify -> RCA -> permanent fix -> regression tests -> postmortem. Mitigation (s3) before RCA (s5) — correct. 90-100 band.

10-mcp-server-scaffold.notes: Explicit ADR-0019 references in s3 (port + mode wrapper). Schema, all 3 tool handlers, registration with schemas, tests. 90-100 band.

ranked_cells.rationale: Highest average quality (91.0 vs 86.7). Wins every task except 03 (tied within 1pt) and 05 (tied within 1pt). Task 02 zero-downtime migration ordering is correct — critical discriminator that rank-2 fails. Task 09 mitigation-before-RCA ordering correct.

Quality delta 4.3 vs rank-1 — outside 3-point tiebreak band, so wall-time speedup (~5x faster: 16.6s vs 80.8s) does not override. Fails task 02 (deploys code before executing migration — the rubric's explicit 70-89 cap). Fastest cell overall; strongest choice under any latency-sensitive routing constraint despite the quality gap.
